blocks.title: Addition polymerisation
blocks.text: Addition polymerisation mein monomers aik aik kar ke aapas mein jurte jate hain aur lambi chains (zanjeerein) banti hain. Asal monomers ke tamam atoms polymer ka hissa ban jate hain.

Koi atom zaya nahi hota. Monomer mein carbon-carbon double bond (C=C) ya triple bond (C≡C) hona zaroori hai. Yeh bond "khul" jata hai aur monomers aik doosre se jur jate hain. Paani jaisa koi chhota molecule side product (saath banne wala product) ke tor par nahi banta. Yeh process aksar "chain reaction" ki shakal mein hota hai, jo aik bohat reactive molecule shuru karta hai; is ko initiator kehte hain, aur yeh free radicals banata hai.
Polyethene mein ethene (CH₂=CH₂) ke bohat se molecules apne double bonds tor kar aik doosre ke saath sire se sira (end-to-end) jur jate hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: n CH2=CH2 + initiator, teer par heat/pressure (garmi/dabao), se [-CH2-CH2-]n; naam ethene aur poly(ethene). Neeche: n displayed (khuli banawat wali) ethene, H2C=CH2 jis ke har kone par H, se bracket mein displayed repeat unit -C(H)(H)-C(H)(H)- aur subscript n. 'Jahan n bohat bara hai, maslan 10 000 tak'.
blocks.caption: Ethene se poly(ethene) ka banna (kitab ke PDF page 146 ki bina number wali figure ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar wali line chhota tareeqa hai: n ethene + initiator, garmi aur pressure par, [-CH₂-CH₂-]ₙ banate hain. Neeche wali drawing mein har ethene ka C=C khul kar single bond ban jata hai, aur bracket ke bahar wale bonds agle unit se jurte hain. n bohat bara number hai, maslan 10 000 tak.
Poly(ethene) ki do bari qismein hain:

items: low density poly(ethene) (LDPE), yani kam density wala
high density poly(ethene) (HDPE), yani zyada density wala

blocks.text: LDPE wahan use hota hai jahan bohat halka aur naram material chahiye, jaise shopping bags aur halki plastic botlein. HDPE ethene se Ziegler-Natta catalyst ki madad se kam pressure aur kam temperature par banaya jata hai; yeh plastic containers (dabbon), mote shopping bags aur khilonon mein use hota hai. LDPE aur HDPE ki chains mukhtalif hain: LDPE ki chains mein zyada branches (shakhein) hain, is liye yeh qareeb qareeb jam nahi saktin, aur material kam solid (thos) aur zyada elastic (lachakdar) hota hai. HDPE ki chains seedhi (linear) hain, is liye yeh qareeb jam jati hain aur material sakht aur dense (ghana) hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is paragraph mein "Zeigler-Natta" chhapti hai. Yeh catalyst Karl Ziegler ke naam par hai, is liye sahi spelling Ziegler-Natta hai, jaise Did You Know? box mein.

blocks.alt: Baen: LDPE ki branched (shakhon wali) chains, neeche 'cannot pack tightly: less solid, more elastic'. Daen: HDPE ki linear (seedhi) chains qareeb qareeb, neeche 'pack closely: tough and dense'.
blocks.caption: LDPE ki branched aur HDPE ki linear chains (is lesson ke liye hamari drawing; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen taraf LDPE ki shakhon wali chains hain jo aik doosre ke qareeb nahi aa saktin, is liye beech mein khali jagah rehti hai. Daen taraf HDPE ki seedhi chains hain jo saf-bandi se qareeb jam jati hain. Yahi farq HDPE ko zyada ghana aur sakht banata hai. (Yeh drawing kitab mein nahi; samjhane ke liye banayi gayi hai.)

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Ziegler-Natta catalysts Nobel Prize jeetne wali invention (ijaad) hain jis ne plastic banane ka tareeqa badal diya. Karl Ziegler ne inhein 1953 mein discover (daryaft) kiya. Is catalyst se pehli dafa ethene ko kam pressure par seedhi chain wale HDPE mein badalna mumkin hua. Baad mein Giulio Natta ne isi catalyst family se stereoregular polymers (jin mein groups aik baqaida tarteeb se lage hon), jaise crystalline polypropylene, banaye.
Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC)
Poly(chloroethene), yani PVC, chloroethene (CH₂=CHCl) naam ke monomer se addition polymerisation ke zariye banta hai.
Neeche scheme mein PVC ka apne monomers se banna zyada tafseel se dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: n CH2=CHCl + initiator se [-CH2-CHCl-]n; naam chloroethene aur poly(chloroethene) ya PVC. Neeche: teen displayed (khuli banawat wale) chloroethene molecules (aik carbon par Cl aur H, doosre par do H) se chhe carbon ki displayed chain jis mein har doosre carbon par Cl aur baqi sab par H.
blocks.caption: Chloroethene se PVC ka banna, condensed aur detailed (kitab ke PDF page 147 ki bina number wali figure ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har chloroethene ka C=C khulta hai aur molecules aapas mein jur kar lambi chain banate hain. Chain mein har doosre carbon par aik Cl hai, kyun ke har monomer apna Cl saath laata hai. Repeat unit -CH₂-CHCl- hai.
PVC aik versatile (kai kaam aane wala) plastic hai. Is mein mukhtalif chemicals, yani plasticizers, mila kar is ki properties ko kaafi badla ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Plasticizers
blocks.text: Plasticizers woh chemicals hain jo kisi material mein is liye milaye jate hain ke woh zyada naram, zyada lachakdar (flexible) aur kaam karne mein aasan ho jaye.
Yeh polymer chains ke darmiyan mazboot forces (kashish) ko kam karte hain, is liye chains zyada aazadi se hil sakti hain.

Rigid (sakht) PVC, yani baghair plasticizers ke, sakht aur akra hua hota hai aur aasani se nahi murta. Yeh chemically inert (doosri cheezon se react na karne wala) hai, kyun ke zyada tar acids, bases aur teil is se react nahi karte. Yeh bijli ka achha insulator (bijli na guzarne dene wala) hai. Chlorine atoms ki wajah se yeh qudrati tor par aag nahi pakarta aur khud hi bujh jata hai (self-extinguishing). Yeh lamba arsa chalta hai aur weathering (dhoop, barish aur mausam) ka asar bardasht karta hai. Plasticised PVC, yani plasticizers wala, naram aur lachakdar hai, is liye aasani se mora aur shakal mein dhala ja sakta hai. Is ki chemical aur electrical properties achhi rehti hain, lekin yeh kam sakht hota hai.
PVC ke industrial (sanati) istemal (Figure 26.2)
PVC ke mukhtalif istemal yeh hain:

items: Paani ki supply, drainage (gande paani ki nikasi) aur sewage ke pipes aur fittings, kyun ke PVC ko corrosion (zang) nahi lagta aur yeh der tak chalta hai.
Khirkiyon ke frame, darwazon ke profiles, farsh ki vinyl tiles aur sheets.
Taaron aur cables par bijli se bachane wali tah (electrical insulation).
Tubing, khoon ke bags (blood bags) aur catheters (jism mein dali jane wali patli nali).
Cling film, botlein (maslan khane ke tel ki) aur blister packs (goliyon ke pattay).
Barsatiyan (raincoats), naqli chamra (artificial leather) aur hawa bhar kar istemal hone wali cheezein (maslan swimming pools).

blocks.prompt: Plasticizer milane se PVC naram aur lachakdar kyun ho jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Plasticizer ke molecules polymer chains ke darmiyan aa jate hain aur chains ke darmiyan mazboot forces ko kam kar dete hain. Is liye chains aasani se aik doosre par sarak sakti hain aur PVC murne lagta hai.

blocks.prompt: LDPE HDPE se kam ghana aur zyada lachakdar kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: LDPE ki chains shakhon wali (branched) hain aur qareeb nahi jam saktin; HDPE ki chains seedhi hain aur qareeb jam kar ghana, sakht material banati hain.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Addition polymerisation: C=C (ya C≡C) wale monomers jurte hain; koi atom zaya nahi hota, koi chhota molecule nahi banta.
Initiator free radicals bana kar chain reaction shuru karta hai.
LDPE shakhon wala aur naram; HDPE seedha, ghana aur sakht (Ziegler-Natta catalyst).
PVC: rigid ya plasticised; pipes, insulation, tubing, blood bags, cling film waghera.
